decisions.scenario: Choosing an expensive Italian restaurant in central Cambridge and asking for Don Pasquale Pizzeria’s postcode

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I’m looking for an expensive Italian restaurant in the centre of Cambridge.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Don Pasquale Pizzeria is an expensive Italian restaurant in the centre.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I don’t need a reservation. Could you give me the postcode?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Certainly. Don Pasquale Pizzeria’s postcode is CB2 3NJ.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That’s all I needed. Thank you.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You’re welcome. Have a good day.

decisions.notes: Retained because postcode CB2 3NJ is new reviewed coverage for Don Pasquale Pizzeria; prior authoring covered a booking but not this postcode.
